generation_steps.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a full-game world-map candidate for Caatuu, a fantasy animal-wizard adventure. Create one FLAT, wide 2:1 full-color world overview, not a sphere and not a collage.

Image 1 is ONLY the approved visual style and world ingredients: charming simplified pixel-art fantasy geography, teal-roof settlements, green meadows, golden earth, turquoise coast, snowy uplands and violet-charcoal cursed terrain. Design completely NEW coastlines and placement. The user wants substantial separate islands and more interesting geography than one huge continent.

High overhead orthographic overview, whole-game scale. Small readable settlements and terrain landmarks, consistent scale throughout. Broad calm areas of open meadow, valley floor, sandy beach and moorland dominate the land so a character could roam freely; faint roads only guide travel. Trees cluster around very wide clearings rather than making a path maze. Simplify surface detail, avoid dense speckling. Create coherent rivers from uplands to the sea, gentle traversable slopes and natural regional transitions. Quiet open ocean surrounds every landmass; no land cropped by the canvas edges. Organic asymmetric coastline silhouettes with bays and peninsulas, substantial land interiors, a little coastal shallows texture.

Across the world include a welcoming central city, a distinct castle, a great forest, a broad fertile valley, generous coast and a dark region with ancient temples, plus a few smaller discoveries such as a port, observatory ruin or snowy ridge. Use large color/shape differences and generous space between landmarks. Islands must be big enough to explore entire regions, not merely decorative rocks. Do not make every island uniformly one biome; allow local variety. Ocean crossings should feel intriguing. Preserve the beautiful, inviting fantasy feel of the reference while making a new layout.
No characters, animals, NPCs, words, labels, titles, numbers, UI, compass rose, route dots, map pins, graticule, tile grid, insets, panel divisions, border or watermark. No photorealism or smooth 3D render. One complete cohesive map per output.

LAYOUT B — THE SHELTERED SEA:
A broad, irregular broken crescent of land curves around a large turquoise central sea, with a wide southern opening to the surrounding deep ocean. The crescent is fat and spacious, with wide plains and valley interiors; do not create a thin ring or a corridor. Its west arm has forested hills and sunny open meadows; its north interior supports a broad river valley and a small snowy ridge; the east arm has grasslands, pale castle uplands and a little amber dry country.
The central city sits on the protected inner northern coast, looking across the sea. A large independent island in the eastern part of that sea contains green coastal meadows transitioning into a mysterious dark temple plateau, with two readable temple landmarks. This island is a substantial adventure destination, not a little rock. It is entirely separated by water from the crescent. A second medium island near the southern opening has pale beaches, a sheltered harbor and old woodland. Keep a clear sea channel through the opening.
The main visual idea is an inviting inner sea whose opposite shores reveal different adventures, and whose settlements face each other across the water. Use an asymmetric horseshoe geography with a generous breathing-space center. Avoid perfect geometric circles, symmetrical continents or evenly spaced islands.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target: Image 1, the selected Caatuu "Sheltered Sea" world map.

Make ONE localized change on the dark island inside the central sea: REMOVE ALL THREE stepped temple buildings. Replace their footprints with continuous natural charcoal-violet rocky ground that matches the surrounding island.

The dark island's sole main landmark should now be ONE PURPLE SOURCE OF DARK MAGIC: a concentrated violet glow emerging from a natural cracked hollow in the earth, with a little low curling purple mist and subtle luminous cracks spreading into the nearby ground. It should look like the origin of the island's dark magic. Keep it restrained, mysterious and readable at this map's overview scale, roughly the footprint of one former temple. No constructed altar, temple, pyramid, tower, shrine, architecture, rows of pillars, several separate sources, huge beam or oversized vortex. Keep the island's existing lighter green coastal terrain and its shoreline.

Preserve everything outside this small dark island as exactly as possible: the entire crescent-shaped mainland, city, mainland castle, mountain structures, ancient forest tree, all coastlines and sea channels, river valleys, southern harbor island, other settlements, roads, vegetation, framing, pixel-art style, detail level, colors and lighting. Do not move, enlarge, crop or redesign the island or any other map feature. The change is strictly the removal of the island's three temples and their replacement with natural dark ground plus one purple magical source. No text, labels, borders, UI, characters or watermark. Return the complete edited map in its original landscape composition.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Image 1 is the edit target: the Caatuu Sheltered Sea map with a single purple source of dark magic on its central dark island.
Image 2 is a reference ONLY for one small detail accidentally lost during the earlier edit: the tiny teal-roof coastal settlement along the lower / southwestern shore of that central dark island.

Restore that small coastal settlement in Image 1, at its original size and original location shown in Image 2 (on the green coastal fringe below and left of the purple dark area, near the lower shore of the central island). Copy only that modest group of tiny coastal houses/teal rooftops and its little connecting ground detail. Keep it small at this world overview scale.

Preserve the entire rest of Image 1: its single glowing purple natural magical fissure, dark rocky terrain, all three former temple sites remaining EMPTY, coastlines, ocean, surrounding crescent mainland, main city, castle, mountains, forests, other southern island, settlements, colors, pixel-art style, framing and composition. Absolutely do not restore any of the three stepped temples from Image 2. No new magical sources. This is a localized restoration of the little coastal village only. Return the full edited map.
